name: 1/7 G.S. Collection [SC] Hatsune Miku Symphony: 10th Anniversary Ver.
description: Celebrate the 10th anniversary of the Hatsune Miku Symphony with this gorgeous new G.S. Collection [SC] (Signature Class)] figure from Good Smile Company! Our girl Miku dances in front of a grand column with her arms spread wide, while golden ribbons bedecked with stars swirl around her! Her extravagantly ruffled skirt and sleeves are carefully sculpted, with even more ruffles at the cuffs of her stockings; a golden ornament atop the column signifies the 10th anniversary. Miku's hair is especially wonderful, flowing softly around and behind her, made of partially painted clear material for a light and airy feel. There's so much detail in this figure, it's almost dizzying -- the delicate white doves holding the ribbons, Miku's crown and the golden roses she wears in her hair, her shining eyes and big smile! This figure will be the centerpiece of your collection -- place your order today! [Figure Size]: Approximately 37cm tall

name: 1/7 G.S. Collection Hatsune Miku: Cheerleading Ver.
1/7 Hatsune Miku: Smile x Future Ver.
description: The grand prize-winning entry from the Hatsune Miku x GSC Illustration Contest is now a delightful 1/7-scale figure from Good Smile Company! The theme was Smile x Future, and this image was brought to us by Okada in the first round of the contest. Miku is seen as a figure repair technician, holding her latest project in her left hand as she pauses for a moment with a paintbrush in her right hand. The wide array of tools attached to her kimono attests to her skill, and all of them are sculpted in amazing detail! Her base is included too. Order her for your own collection today! [Figure Size]: Approximately 26.5cm tall

name: POP UP PARADE Hatsune Miku Symphony: 2020 Ver. L Size
Look Up Hatsune Miku
description: This adorable Look Up figure of the Vocaloid Hatsune Miku is in fact looking up at you! This figure lineup from MegaHouse has been specifically designed to be easier to see when you display it on your desk; with its large volume, slightly super-deformed design, and movable head, this figure will make you smile every time you see it! Place your order today! [Figure Size]: Approximately 11cm tallOther figures shown are not included.

name: 1/7 Hatsune Miku: 100th Adventure Ver.
description: Good Smile Company brings us a new 1/7-scale figure of Hatsune Miku, based on the key visual for the 100th Nendoroid Hatsune Miku Commemorative Exhibition! This figure brings the original illustration by KEI to life, giving us a vibrant Miku in a steampunk-inspired explorer's outfit! Her wing-like twin tails are made with translucent parts for a beautiful, breezy appearance, and her base is included. Order her for your own collection today! [Figure Size]: Approximately 24.5cm tall

name: 1/7 Hatsune Miku with SOLWA (Rerelease)
description: Hatsune Miku collaborates with the premium brand COCOLLABO and their apparel brand SOLWA to bring us this delightful figure from Good Smile Company! Based on a special illustration by the popular artist Mai Yoneyama, this figure gives Miku's iconic twin tails a water-like appearance, and her stunning jacket is made with clear parts that are partially painted with shiny metallic paint for an astounding level of detail. Her base is included. Order her for your own collection today! [Figure Size]: Approximately 24cm tall

name: Hatsune Miku Series Fuwapuchi Deformed Figure New Semester
1/4 Hatsune Miku: Bunny Ver. / Art by SanMuYYB (Rerelease)
description: Freeing's 1/4-scale figure of Hatsune Miku in a bunny suit, based on a specially drawn illustration by SanMuYYB, is back! Her uniquely styled monotone bunny suit, real fishnet tights, and her delicate hair made with translucent materials all combine to make this a truly amazing figure that you'll love having on display in your collection -- and she's 1/4-scale, too, making her impressively super-sized to grab all the attention! Order her today! [Figure Size]: Approximately 30cm tall

name: 1/7 Hatsune Miku: HATSUNE MIKU Digital Stars 2024 ver.
description: The popular illustrator BUNBUN provided the artwork for the main visual for HATSUNE MIKU Digital Stars 2024, and now Miku can join your collection in figure form thanks to Hobby Stock! The visual theme was Glitch x DJ, and we think you'll agree that Miku makes a great DJ! Her smile, her outfit, and the base that's been designed to resemble a record all combine to make this figure something really special. Order her for your own collection today! [Figure Size]: Approximately 22cm tall, including base [Materials]: ABS, PVC
